Per-state log-likelihood ratios and scores per cell x region

Source: R/caller.R
score_cells.Rd

Per state (vs neutral): depth term = ll_depth_shift() with mu = shift / pmax(ifelse(is.na(sd_null), 1, sd_null), sd_floor) under the Student-t null of the row's class x stratum (match_depth_null()) or N(0, 1); allelic term = best of the state's rows of ll_allelic() (two-sided); combined = sum (missing channels contribute 0). A state whose rows have different shifts (tumour amp) takes the best row of depth + alleles and reports that row's two terms.

Usage

score_cells(
  d,
  states = caller_states("normal"),
  tpar = NULL,
  rho,
  eps = params$eps,
  depth_model = c("t", "gauss"),
  params = caller_defaults(),
  keep_rows = FALSE
)

Arguments

d

table with z, sd_null, nA, n_hap (or nB), and class, stratum for the t model

states

caller_states() table

tpar

fit_depth_null() output (t model)

rho

beta-binomial overdispersion of the null allele votes (fit_allelic_null()): one value, or one per row (e.g. per chromosome, rho_by_chrom()); rows are then scored in groups of equal rho

eps

allele error floor

depth_model

"t" or "gauss"

params

caller_defaults() (sd_floor, eps)

keep_rows

also return per-row allelic LLRs ar_<row_id> (and per-row depth LLRs dr_<row_id> of multi-shift states); needed by pool_scores()

Value

copy of d with dl_<state>, al_<state>, cl_<state> per non-neutral state, s_comb (best combined LLR), state_comb (argmax, ties to the first state in table order), s_depth (|z|), state_depth (sign), s_allelic (best allelic LLR), state_allelic (best allelic class, e.g. loss_or_cnloh)
